name: HZ_GEOGRAPHIES_INT
description:
HZ_GEOGRAPHIES_INT is an interface table to load data to TCA geography tables such as HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS, HZ_RELATIONSHIPS, and HZ_HIERARCHY_NODES. 

SOURCE_ID and PARENT_SOURCE_ID are arbitrary user-provided numbers to connect a geography and its parent within a job id of this interface table. For example, if United States has a SOURCE_ID 1, all states under it should have the PARENT_SOURCE_ID 1.  All counties under California must have a PARENT_SOURCE_ID 22 if SOURCE_ID of California is 22.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this interface record. (internal use only)

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography import batch in HZ_IMP_BATCH_SUMMARY.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies what data needs to be created.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of geography.

columns.name: PRIMARY_GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Primary name of the geography.

columns.name: PRIMARY_GEOGRAPHY_CODE
columns.description: Primary code of the geography.

columns.name: PRIMARY_GEOGRAPHY_CODE_TYPE
columns.description: Primary code type of the geography.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs.

columns.name: LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Country structure level number.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: User identifier of this geography.

columns.name: PARENT_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: User identifier of parent geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier of the parent used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of parent geography (internal use only).

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Relationship identifier for this geography and its parent in HZ_RELATIONSHIPS table (internal use only).

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this geography is valid for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this geography is no longer valid.

columns.name: GEO_DATA_PROVIDER
columns.description: Name of the data source provider.

columns.name: PROVIDER_GEO_ID
columns.description: Identifier provided by the geography data provider.

columns.name: PARENT_PROVIDER_GEO_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the parent provided by the geography data provider.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the language in which identifier_value is stored. (Foreign key to FND_ LANGUAGES.LANGUAGE_CODE)

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Time zone of the geography (Foreign key to FND_TIMEZONES_B.TIMZONE_CODE)

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies whether the value in identifier_value is a code or a name .

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Specifies the type of a code or a name.

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_VALUE
columns.description: Stores the value of the identifier type.

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated (internal use only).

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Error ID in HZ_IMP_ERRORS. (internal use only)

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File import wizard uses this column to relate records in this interface table to rows in a file. (internal use only)

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: File import wizard status: I - In Progress,  O - Obsolete(This would be the status of all the interface table records that were run before),  E - Errored, S - Successful (internal use only)

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert(I), move(M), delete(D) or update(U) for internal use.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography in HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS table (internal use only), used as primary key for master geography export

columns.name: PREV_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Previous geography identifier of existing geography for move use case (internal use only).

columns.name: PREV_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of geography before move operation. This will be used to restore the end date if Incremental Geography Import fails during move operation.
